methods.CAPRA-F-Only: Original GpuStage once; frozen R5 DirectPlacement.prepare_f only; same RepairAllocator, no select/construct_d/DP/D_AFTER; one original commit_v2

Each Direct scenario first completed-D nonempty round with R_D>R_F+EPS but Phi_D<Phi_F-EPS
Each complete Direct/F-only scenario maximum absolute positive JCT degradation, tie job_id; absent if none
